class ControlledSequenceSampler:
    """Main-process sampler; no workers, prefetching, or mutable model context."""

    def __init__(self, histories, itemnum, route):
        self.histories = histories
        self.itemnum = itemnum
        self.route = route
        self.users = [u for u, history in histories.items() if len(history) >= 2]
        if not self.users or itemnum < 1:
            raise ValueError("Training requires eligible users and a nonempty catalog")
        self.rows = {u: row for row, u in enumerate(sorted(histories))}
        self.exclusions = {u: set(histories[u]) - {0} for u in self.users}
        for excluded in self.exclusions.values():
            if any(i < 1 or i > itemnum for i in excluded):
                raise ValueError("Training history contains an invalid catalog ID")
        self.order_rng = random.Random(42)

    def sample(self, batch_size, maxlen, epoch, batch_index):
        if batch_size < 1 or maxlen < 1:
            raise ValueError("Batch size and sequence length must be positive")
        sequences = np.zeros((batch_size, maxlen), dtype=np.int64)
        positives = np.zeros_like(sequences)
        ids = np.zeros((batch_size, 32), dtype=np.int64)
        available = np.zeros((batch_size, 32), dtype=bool)
        for row in range(batch_size):
            user = self.order_rng.choice(self.users)
            history = self.histories[user]
            length = min(maxlen, len(history) - 1)
            sequences[row, -length:] = history[-length - 1:-1]
            positives[row, -length:] = history[-length:]
            excluded = self.exclusions[user]
            if not set(positives[row, -length:]).difference({0}).issubset(excluded):
                raise AssertionError("Every training target must be excluded")
            eligible_count = self.itemnum - len(excluded)
            count = min(32, eligible_count)
            if count == 0:
                continue
            occurrence = batch_index * batch_size + row
            rng = np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(np.random.SeedSequence(
                [42, self.route, epoch, self.rows[user], occurrence]
            )))
            # Fixed training-only policy; complements are not cached.
            if len(excluded) * 2 >= self.itemnum or eligible_count < 64:
                complement = np.fromiter(
                    (i for i in range(1, self.itemnum + 1) if i not in excluded),
                    dtype=np.int64, count=eligible_count,
                )
                chosen = rng.choice(complement, size=count, replace=False)
            else:
                chosen, accepted = [], set()
                while len(chosen) < count:
                    item = int(rng.integers(1, self.itemnum + 1))
                    if item not in excluded and item not in accepted:
                        chosen.append(item)
                        accepted.add(item)
                chosen = np.asarray(chosen, dtype=np.int64)
            if len(set(chosen.tolist())) != count or any(i in excluded for i in chosen):
                raise AssertionError("Negative uniqueness/exclusion invariant failed")
            ids[row, :count] = chosen
            available[row, :count] = True
        return sequences, positives, ids, available


def controlled_data_loss(model, sequence, positive, negative, available):
    """Mean over valid positions, matching the supplied baseline reduction."""
    features = model.log2feats(sequence)
    negative = negative[:, :NEGATIVE_COUNT]
    available = available[:, :NEGATIVE_COUNT] & negative.ne(0)
    valid = sequence.ne(0) & positive.ne(0) & available.any(-1).unsqueeze(-1)
    if not bool(valid.any()):
        return features.sum() * 0.0, valid
    collision = (
        negative.unsqueeze(1).eq(positive.unsqueeze(-1))
        & available.unsqueeze(1)
        & positive.ne(0).unsqueeze(-1)
    )
    if bool(collision.any()):
        raise AssertionError("Shared negative collides with a training target")
    positive_logits = model.predict_score(features, positive, "aligned").float()
    # Embed each shared candidate once; avoid allocating B x L x K x D.
    negative_logits = torch.bmm(
        features, model.item_emb(negative).transpose(1, 2)
    ).float()
    mask = available.unsqueeze(1).expand_as(negative_logits)[valid]
    p = positive_logits[valid]
    n = negative_logits[valid]
    if OBJECTIVE == "bce":
        negative_terms = nn.functional.softplus(n).masked_fill(~mask, 0.0)
        losses = nn.functional.softplus(-p) + negative_terms.sum(-1) / mask.sum(-1)
    else:
        logits = torch.cat((p.unsqueeze(-1), n.masked_fill(~mask, -torch.inf)), -1)
        losses = nn.functional.cross_entropy(
            logits, torch.zeros(p.shape[0], dtype=torch.long, device=p.device),
            reduction="none",
        )
    return losses.mean(), valid
